$comment: Machine-readable acquisition record for every browser vendor asset served from
the same origin under /vendor. Each entry pins the upstream npm package, the
exact version, the public registry tarball and its registry-published subresource
integrity, the path inside that tarball, the served destination, the upstream
license, and the SHA-256 of the FINAL SHIPPED BYTES in this repository.
'transformations' is the complete list of modifications applied between the
tarball source bytes and the shipped bytes. An empty array means the shipped
file is byte-identical to the tarball source. Exactly one file is transformed:
This file records public registry provenance only. It never contains local
filesystem paths, credentials, tokens, cookies, or private registry state.
Verified in-suite by the 'self-hosted-vendor' gate in scripts/quality-gates.js

packages.name: leaflet

transformations: Removed the 35-byte trailing source-map comment '//# sourceMappingURL=leaflet.js.map'. Nothing else was changed: the shipped bytes are a byte-exact prefix of the 147552-byte tarball source. Pre-existing, reviewed under the post-11.8B Leaflet vendor cleanup and preserved unchanged by R6.

packages.notes: leaflet.css resolves images/layers.png, images/layers-2x.png and images/marker-icon.png relatively, so the images/ directory must stay a sibling of leaflet.css. The .leaflet-default-icon-path rule in that stylesheet is how L.Icon.Default auto-detects the marker image directory, which is why no marker URL is hard-coded in any view.

packages.name: maplibre-gl
packages.notes: This is the standard UMD bundle — the exact file previously loaded from the CDN. It creates its web worker from a blob: URL, which the existing worker-src 'self' blob: directive already permits, so NO separate worker file is shipped. The dist/maplibre-gl-csp.js + dist/maplibre-gl-csp-worker.js pair is the alternative for a blob-free CSP and is deliberately NOT used: adopting it would change the runtime rather than self-host the current one. maplibre-gl.css embeds every control image as a data: URI, so it needs no sibling image directory.

packages.name: pannellum
packages.notes: pannellum.css references exactly five images and every one of them is an inline data:image/svg+xml URI, so the built stylesheet has no relative image dependency and no sibling image directory is required. The upstream build/ directory ships no image files at all.

packages.name: iconify-icon
packages.notes: Self-hosting moves only the COMPONENT SCRIPT on-origin. The component still fetches icon DATA from https://api.iconify.design at runtime, which remains an approved connect-src data origin. The executable script origin https://code.iconify.design is removed.

packages.name: pmtiles
packages.notes: OFF.3 self-hosted PMTiles browser reader. The package archive omits its license file, so LICENSE is pinned to the npm artifact's exact gitHead. The offline manager reads a user-downloaded, integrity-checked local Blob; no remote executable or tile host is contacted while offline.

packages.name: lucide
packages.notes: Resolves the former floating 'lucide@latest' CDN reference to an exact reviewed version. A floating tag meant every admin page executed whatever build the CDN served at request time, with no reviewed provenance.

approvedExternalOrigins.$comment: The COMPLETE set of external origins the browser may still contact after R6. NONE of them serves executable JavaScript. Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com) is the SOLE permitted external STYLESHEET exception; the other origins serve only fonts, map tiles, icon data, or media, never a stylesheet or a script.
approvedExternalOrigins.https://fonts.googleapis.com: Google Fonts stylesheet (explicit documented exception; imported by public/css/styles.css).
approvedExternalOrigins.https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org: Approved OpenStreetMap raster map tiles (img-src / connect-src only).
approvedExternalOrigins.https://api.iconify.design: Iconify icon DATA API used by the now self-hosted component (connect-src only).
approvedExternalOrigins.https://res.cloudinary.com: Owner-controlled Cloudinary media delivery for campus images and 360 panoramas (img-src / media-src / connect-src only).

removedExecutableOrigins.$comment: Executable script/style origins removed from the CSP by R6. No runtime asset is served from any of them any more.
removedExecutableOrigins.https://unpkg.com: Formerly served Leaflet CSS, MapLibre GL JS + CSS, and lucide@latest.
removedExecutableOrigins.https://code.iconify.design: Formerly served the iconify-icon component script.
